paper: W. J. Tomlinson, R. H. Stolen, A. M. Johnson, Optical wave breaking of pulses in nonlinear optical fibers, Opt. Lett. 10, 457 (1985)
description: Optical wave breaking: an SPM-broadened pulse propagating in the NORMAL-dispersion regime develops steep edges (a shock) and then oscillations. Reproduces the standard chirp-folding criterion z_WB = (e^{3/4}/2) sqrt(L_D L_NL) and validates the z_WB ~ sqrt(L_D L_NL) ~ P0^{-1/2} scaling with the GNLSE solver.
pdf_note: The Opt. Lett. PDF is paywalled and could not be downloaded here; representative silica-fibre parameters are used and the analytic criterion is derived from the standard SPM chirp (Agrawal, Nonlinear Fiber Optics, Sec. 4.1.3). No page images are included.

reference.note: Analytic values for the reference case (P0 = 10 W).
